# gitmoap_group_milestones (Data Source)

List a scope's milestones. Returns every milestone the group defines, open and closed, newest first. Anyone who can see the group's work items may list them — on a public group, without signing in.

The token needs `issue:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Optional

- `search` (String) Autocomplete fragment — keeps milestones whose title or description contains it, ignoring case

### Read-Only

- `group_milestones` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_milestones))

<a id="nestedatt--group_milestones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_milestones`

Read-Only:

- `closed` (Boolean)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `due_on` (String) A calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, with no time and no zone — a due date, or the day an iteration starts or ends.
- `milestone_id` (String)
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)
- `title` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
